title: test(cli): tmpdir fixtures that run pnpm reach no registry (dev-no-watch pin, doctor readers, init leg)
body:
Fixes #24419

Clause-②: no

Basis for the Clause-② line: every changed file is under `packages/cli/test/**`, the CLI's test harness. `@objectstack/cli` publishes `dist`, `README.md` and `CHANGELOG.md` (its `files[]`). Measured on head `8994da181`, after `pnpm turbo run build --filter='@objectstack/cli...'`: the identifiers this PR adds (`derivePackageManagerPin`, `packageManagerPin`, `PACKAGE_ROOT`, `STUB_PNPM_VERSION`, `writeStubPnpm`, `stubBinDir`, `fixtureRoot`) occur in 0 of those files. The positive control `devWatchActive`, which comes from `src/`, occurs in 2. Nothing published moves, so this PR carries the `skip-changeset` label and no changeset.

## The pin's shape: derived from pnpm (option B, the seat's decision)

The first head (`bd0651500`) read the `packageManager` pin from the root `package.json`. That read leaves `packages/cli`, so `check:cross-package-test-inputs` went red, and declaring it needed three files outside the claim's file surface. The work stopped there, and the seat chose option B (PR thread, patch round 1).

The pin is now derived. `dev-no-watch.pin.test.ts` runs `pnpm --version` with `cwd` = `packages/cli` and writes `pnpm@VERSION` into the fixtures. That answer is the root pin, reached through Corepack's own walk. No root file is read and no new turbo input is declared. `check:cross-package-test-inputs` exits 0 on `8994da181`, and `turbo.json`, `scripts/cross-package-test-inputs.mjs` and `scripts/check-cross-package-test-inputs.mjs` are untouched (`git diff db1f1fd20 HEAD` is empty for all three).

Why B:
- The card's acceptance is that the test reaches no network. B meets it, and the pin is derived rather than copied by hand.
- A would have made the root `package.json` an input of `@objectstack/cli#test`. Every PR that edits it would then add cli's PR-tier suite to Test Core. Measured: a root-`package.json`-only edit gives `turbo ls --affected` 0 packages today (the control, a `packages/types/package.json` edit, gives 69 including cli). On `origin/main`, 42 of the last 300 commits (since 2026-10-16) touched the root `package.json` and no `packages/`, `examples/` or `apps/` path.

What B leaves, stated in the file's own comment: the pin is an undeclared input, so a pin-only bump does not re-run this file. This suite's other `pnpm -v` and `pnpm pack` callers have the same blind spot, so B adds no new class of it. The fixture spec carries no integrity hash, and the derivation costs one extra spawn.

Option A's patch was measured and not taken. On `bd0651500`, three edits turned the gate green with `check-ci-filter-parity` also green, and were then restored (blob equal to HEAD, `git diff HEAD` empty for all three):
- `turbo.json`: `"$TURBO_ROOT$/package.json"` in the `@objectstack/cli#test` inputs;
- `scripts/cross-package-test-inputs.mjs`: `'package.json'` in the cli globs;
- `scripts/check-cross-package-test-inputs.mjs`: `'package.json'` in the pinned `TURBO_ROOT_FILE_INPUTS` roster.

## The premise, measured on `db1f1fd20` before any change

CI's runner shape was rebuilt locally as `.github/actions/setup-pnpm` leaves it: Corepack shims first on `PATH`, and a private `COREPACK_HOME` holding exactly the pinned `pnpm@10.31.0` (materialised with `corepack install` in the repo root, with no `lastKnownGood.json`). The registry was made unreachable: `COREPACK_NPM_REGISTRY` and `npm_config_registry` point at a local server that answers HTTP 429 to every request and logs each one. A logging `pnpm` shim in front of Corepack's records every pnpm call's cwd and argv.

- **Mechanism.** In a bare `tmpdir()` directory, `pnpm --version` sent `GET /pnpm/latest` and exited 1 with `Server answered with HTTP 429 when performing the request to …/pnpm/latest`. That is CI's signature on PR #24415. The same directory with a `package.json` carrying the root pin: `10.31.0`, 0 requests.
- **`dev-no-watch.pin.test.ts`, unchanged:** the same two tests CI failed went red. "and the failure is pnpm refusing the PACKAGE…" failed with `AssertionError: os dev ended with code 1`. "the fixture starts its own dev script when asked — the control" failed with `expected 1 to be +0`. Both outputs carry the 429 line. The `--no-watch` spawn never runs pnpm, because the refusal comes first. "`os dev --watch=false` exits 1 instead of 0" stayed GREEN under the 429, because Corepack's failure exits 1 too. Only its sibling assertion on pnpm's own sentence tells the two apart.

## The shape, and why

The fixtures carry the repository's own pin as `pnpm@VERSION`, where VERSION is what `pnpm --version` answers in `packages/cli` (see the section above). Nothing is copied by hand. It is the one version CI's Corepack store already holds, so it resolves with no network call.

- **Where the pin sits.** One fixture root holds both fixtures, and its `package.json` carries the pin. `workspace/package.json` carries it too, because it is the nearest manifest. `project/` holds no manifest. Measured with pnpm 10.31.0: a `package.json` inside the project directory changes pnpm's answer from `No projects found in "…"` (the sentence this file pins) to `No projects matched the filters in "…"`. With the pin one level up, the answer is unchanged.
- **Why not the env route.** `COREPACK_DEFAULT_TO_LATEST=0` does not remove the network reach in CI's shape. It swaps `latest` for Corepack's own bundled default, which the store does not hold. Measured: `GET /pnpm/10.13.1`, 429, exit 1. `COREPACK_ENABLE_NETWORK=0` would only turn the fetch into a refusal.
- The two tests keep their subjects: pnpm's no-projects refusal, and the `--no-watch` refusal against a fixture whose `dev` script runs.

## The family census

Method: the CLI paths that run pnpm were enumerated from every child-process call site in `packages/cli/src`. There are three: `os dev` monorepo mode (`pnpm … dev`), `os doctor` (`pnpm -v`), and `os init` (`PM install`). Tests that spawn pnpm directly, or drive one of those three paths, were enumerated by `git grep` over the command literals. Each candidate was then run in the CI shape above, with the registry refused.

| File | Runs pnpm? | cwd | Pin in reach? | Registry, measured before | Verdict |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `test/dev-no-watch.pin.test.ts` | `os dev` → `pnpm --filter false … dev`, `pnpm dev` | `tmpdir()` | no | 2 × `GET /pnpm/latest`, 2 tests red | **fixed**: pin derived from `pnpm --version` in `packages/cli` |
| `test/package-owned-command-readers.test.ts` | `os doctor` → `pnpm -v` (2 children) | `tmpdir()` | no | 2 × `GET /pnpm/latest`, tests GREEN (doctor turns a failed probe into a row) | **fixed**: a stub `pnpm` on `PATH` answers `-v` and refuses anything else. A new `it` per shape asserts the stub was reached |
| `test/create-refuses-invalid-project-name.e2e.test.ts` (nightly tier) | `os init NAME` (no `--no-install`) → `pnpm install` | `tmpdir()` scaffold (no pin, on purpose) | no | 1 × `GET /pnpm/latest`, 1 test red. With a working registry it installs the scaffold's dependencies from npm | **fixed**: `--no-install`. The leg's subject is that `init` accepts the name |
| `test/init.test.ts` | no: renders templates in-process | n/a | n/a | 0 pnpm calls | no reach |
| `test/init-created-files-summary.e2e.test.ts` | a fake `pnpm` leads `PATH` | `tmpdir()` | n/a | 0 real pnpm calls, 0 requests | no reach |
| `test/published-subpath-console.pin.test.ts` | `pnpm pack` | `packages/cli` | yes | 0 requests | no reach (`tmpdir()` is only `--pack-destination`) |
| `test/published-subpath-hook-body.pin.test.ts` | `pnpm pack` | `packages/cli` | yes | 0 requests | no reach |
| `src/commands/doctor-*.test.ts` (10 files, in-process `Doctor.run`) | `pnpm -v` | the process's real cwd, `packages/cli` (they spy `process.cwd()`, which a child never reads) | yes | 87 calls, 0 requests | no reach |
| `test/create-objectstack-stack-reach.test.ts` (found by the whole-tier run below; the grep missed it) | `pnpm --version` | `packages/cli/node_modules/.create-objectstack-reach-*` | yes | 0 requests (measured at `bd0651500`) | no reach |

Other `os dev` spawns refuse before pnpm (`--no-watch`) or boot one environment (`--artifact`, a config in cwd). Other `os init` spawns refuse before the install, pass `--no-install`, or stub `npm`. `exit-signal.pin.test.ts` mocks `child_process`.

**Whole PR tier, after the fix, in the CI shape with the registry refused** (head `bd0651500`):
- `--project unit`: 311 files, 4610 tests passed, **0 registry requests**. The only pnpm calls were the two `pnpm pack` runs and 87 × `pnpm -v`, all in `packages/cli`.
- `--project integration`: 160 files, 159 passed + 1 skipped (a pre-existing skip in a file this PR does not touch), 1375 tests passed + 9 skipped, **0 registry requests**. pnpm was called by dev-no-watch's two spawns (pinned) and by `create-objectstack-stack-reach.test.ts`'s `pnpm --version` in `packages/cli/node_modules/…`, where the root pin is in reach. That file is the table's last row.

Patch round 1 (`8994da181`) changes only `dev-no-watch.pin.test.ts`. That file was re-proved on the new head (see Proof); the whole-tier readings above were taken on `bd0651500`.

The nightly tier was not run whole. Its pnpm-reaching candidates are the two `.e2e` rows above, each measured.

## Proof: the converted tests with the registry refused

- Head `8994da181`: `dev-no-watch.pin` + `package-owned-command-readers` 16/16 passed, **0 registry requests**. The derivation's `pnpm --version` ran in `packages/cli`. The pnpm calls in `/tmp/os-dev-no-watch-*/project` and `…/workspace` resolved to `10.31.0` from the store.
- Head `bd0651500`, files unchanged since: `create-refuses-invalid-project-name.e2e` + `init-created-files-summary.e2e` (`OS_TEST_TIERS=nightly`) 10/10 passed, **0 registry requests**.
- The Corepack store still holds exactly `v1/pnpm/10.31.0`, with no `lastKnownGood.json`.
- Also green in this container's default shape (a standalone pnpm 10.28.0, not Corepack), with both registries refused, on `8994da181`: `dev-no-watch.pin` 8/8, 0 requests.

## Ablation (`scripts/ablation-replace.mjs`, wrap mode, fix committed first, head `8994da181`)

- Anchor `packageManager: packageManagerPin` (2 hits, `--expect 2`), replaced with `packageManager: undefined`. On disk: anchor 2 → 0, replacement 0 → 2, blob `0881d577b041` → `1df76c152cb3`.
- With the registry refused, it went RED, the expected direction. The same two tests failed as in the premise run: "and the failure is pnpm refusing the PACKAGE…" and "the fixture starts its own dev script when asked — the control". 6 passed, and there were 2 × `GET /pnpm/latest`.
- Restore: blob after restore `0881d577b041` equals HEAD, `git diff HEAD` empty, `git status --porcelain` empty.
- The same ablation on `bd0651500`'s read-the-manifest shape gave the same red: 2 failed, 2 requests, restore proven.

## Tiers

The tiers are unchanged. `vitest-tiers.ts`'s `tierSignals` gives the same answer for each changed file before (`db1f1fd20`), on `bd0651500` and on `8994da181`. For `dev-no-watch.pin` and `create-refuses-…e2e`: integration (`childProcess, entryBasename, tsxBin`). For `package-owned-command-readers`: integration (`childProcess, helperCliOrTsx`). The e2e file keeps its nightly name. `test/vitest-tiers-partition.test.ts` passed (22/22 on `8994da181`).

## Gates (local, head `8994da181`)

- `node scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs --commands --repo objectstack-ai/objectstack`: 52 derived commands, each run with its exit code captured before any pipe. All 52 exited 0, `pnpm check:cross-package-test-inputs` included.
  - `pnpm check:dual-build-cjs-loads` first answered 3, PREREQUISITE NOT MET: the fresh worktree had no `dist/` for packages outside cli's closure, so that run measured nothing. A later gate in the battery (`check:type-check-debt`) built them, and the re-run exited 0.
  - The head is behind `origin/main`, and the derivation flagged two gate files changed there. The same derivation on a tree at `origin/main` `725a5b131`, with this diff applied, gives the identical 52 commands.
- The 11 declared-wide families were each run and exited 0. `pnpm check:cli-test-child-env` exited 0.
- `--ran` reconciliation: 52 derived, 52 run, 0 NOT-MEASURED (a derived zero: all 52 recorded an exit code), 0 UNRUN.
- `eslint --no-inline-config` over the 3 changed files: exit 0, 0 errors, 0 warnings, none ignored.
- `pnpm --filter @objectstack/cli typecheck`: exit 0. `tsc -p tsconfig.test.json --listFiles` lists all 3 changed files. Its 28 errors are exactly the ledgered `test-typecheck-debt.json` set, none in these files.
- CI on `8994da181`, read before this reply: 33 success, 7 skipped, 0 failures. All five required contexts are green (`Lint & Repo Gates`, `TypeScript Type Check`, `Test Core`, `Build Core`, `Governed Surface Queue Guard`).

## Acceptance notes

- `os doctor`'s pnpm row misreports a Corepack fetch failure as `✗ pnpm Not found → Install pnpm: npm install -g pnpm@10.28.1`, and prints Corepack's stack trace above the report. Measured in a `tmpdir()` with no pin under Corepack, with the registry answering 429. Filed as #24464, not fixed here (`packages/cli/src/**` is held off).
- In the 10 in-process doctor tests, the `process.cwd()` spy does not reach `doctor`'s `pnpm -v` child, which runs in the real cwd. That is harmless here (the pin is in reach) and is noted only.
